description: Use for events by name, date, region or layer: Wikidata battles, UCDP armed conflict since 1989, Smithsonian GVP eruptions of VEI 4+, NOAA earthquakes, witnessed meteorite falls and undated UNESCO World Heritage sites. Returns a date-sorted page of events with recorded date precision, coordinates, attribution and map links. Month/day bounds require matching source precision; undated sites need an unbounded date search. For borders in a year, use world_at_year.

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in degrees.

from_date.description: Source-calendar date fields at month precision, or day precision when day is supplied. Historical sources may use Julian dates; bounds compare their recorded fields without calendar conversion.

year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

from_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

lang.description: Site language for returned page and map links. Use the language the user is writing in.

layer.description: Event dataset: conflict is Wikidata battles; ucdp is armed conflict. The other values select eruptions, earthquakes, meteorite falls or heritage sites.

limit.description: Maximum results to return in this page.

offset.description: Pass the previous result’s next_offset with the same filters to continue.

query.description: Substring of the event name or detail, e.g. "Vienna".

to_date.description: Source-calendar date fields at month precision, or day precision when day is supplied. Historical sources may use Julian dates; bounds compare their recorded fields without calendar conversion.

year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

to_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

name: search_events

year.description: Display year, or null for an undated event.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page with the same filters, or null at the end.

returned.description: Number of records in this page.
